items.badge_description:
Feet in the sand and a can in your hand while you watch the waves roll in.

That's a beer at 5 different venues categorized as a beach! Visit 5 more for Level 2!

It's time to give bottle shops some love by adding them as your purchased location. That's 470 check-ins with a purchased location! Tag 5 more to get to Level 95. Want to learn more about this badge? Check out our podcast

Kiwis, rugby and sheep aren’t the only things New Zealand has to offer. There’s a ton of great beers in a variety of styles just waiting for you to explore! That's 90 different beers from a brewery in New Zealand. Try 5 more for Level 19.

Hiking, fishing, swimming - there are so many wonderful things to do while you enjoy the great outdoors. Even beer is better when surrounded by the beauty of nature. That's 5 different venues categorized as Great Outdoors. Visit 5 more for Level 2!

Want to enjoy a day of brews, but need to keep your wits sharp? There are plenty of delicious brews under 5% for you to sip on throughout the day. That's 350 different beers with an ABV of 5% and lower.

Fresh from the tap is one of the best ways to enjoy a beer. Just try to use a glass and not drink directly from the tap, as tempting as it may be. That's 20 checkins with the serving style of Draft. Try 5 more for Level 5!
